# batches_openai
# an OpenAI batch of two lines: upload, create, poll to completion, read the output file
# normalized: created, times, ids
POST /v1/files
--wirecensusboundary\r
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="purpose"\r
\r
batch\r
--wirecensusboundary\r
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="in.jsonl"\r
Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r
\r
{"custom_id":"a","method":"POST","url":"/v1/chat/completions","body":{"model":"tiny","max_tokens":3,"temperature":0,"logit_bias":{"66":100},"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi a"}]}}
{"custom_id":"b","method":"POST","url":"/v1/chat/completions","body":{"model":"tiny","max_tokens":3,"temperature":0,"logit_bias":{"66":100},"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi b"}]}}
\r
--wirecensusboundary--\r
